options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name (part of the button name).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label (it stays in the accessible name).

options.name: description
options.description: Help text, referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name; also set on the native input for native submission.

options.name: multiple
options.description: Allow several files; a new selection appends. Single mode replaces the file.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial files; reset() restores them.

options.name: required
options.description: At least one file is required.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable the button, drop zone, and remove buttons.

options.name: acceptTypes
options.description: Accepted MIME types ("image/png", "image/*"). Every file is checked.

options.name: acceptExtensions
options.description: Accepted extensions including the dot (".pdf"). When both lists are set, a file must match both.

options.name: maxFileSize
options.description: Maximum size of each file, in bytes.

options.name: maxTotalSize
options.description: Maximum combined size, in bytes.

options.name: maxFiles
options.description: Maximum number of files (requires multiple).

options.name: buttonText
options.description: Button text. Default: localized "Choose file" / "Choose files".

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ upload: IconRef; file: IconRef; remove: IconRef; error: IconRef }>
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: dropZone
options.description: Render the drag-and-drop zone around the button.

options.name: showConstraints
options.description: Render a hint listing the type, size, and count limits.

options.name: locale
options.description: Message and size-formatting locale.

properties.name: input
properties.description: The native file input (hidden; the button opens it).

properties.name: rejections
properties.description: Files not added by the last selection, with reasons.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible label (used by the error summary).

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: A copy of the selected files.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Replace the selection (no events, no filtering; violations make the value invalid).

methods.name: openPicker
methods.description: Open the native chooser (needs user activation).

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now (marks the control submitted) and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); null clears it.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Move focus to the primary focusable element.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, registration, listeners, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { files: readonly File[]; added: readonly File[]; removed: readonly File[]; validity: FileUploadValidity }
events.description: The user added (chooser or drop) or removed files.

events.name: aui-reject
events.detail: { rejected: readonly { file: File; reason: FileRejectionReason; message: string }[] }
events.description: A selection contained files that were not added.

cssClasses.name: aui-file-upload__item
cssClasses.description: One file row (--invalid when it breaks a rule).
